title: Diagnosing LLM Reranker Behavior Under Fixed Evidence Pools
abstract: arXiv:2602.18613v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard reranking evaluations study how a reranker orders candidates returned by an upstream retriever. This setup couples ranking behavior with retrieval quality, so differences in output cannot be attributed to the ranking policy alone. We introduce a controlled diagnostic for reranking that uses Multi-News clusters as fixed evidence pools. We limit each pool to eight documents and pass identical inputs to all rankers. Within this setup, BM25 and MMR serve as interpretable reference points for lexical matching and diversity optimization. Across 345 clusters, we find that redundancy patterns vary by model: one LLM implicitly diversifies at larger selection budgets, while another increases redundancy. In contrast, LLMs underperform on lexical coverage at small selection budgets. translated_title: 固定证据池下LLM重排序器行为的诊断研究
translated_abstract: 标准的重排序评估研究的是重排序器如何对上游检索器返回的候选结果进行排序。这种设置将排序行为与检索质量耦合在一起，因此输出差异不能仅归因于排序策略本身。我们引入了一种使用Multi-News聚类作为固定证据池的重排序受控诊断方法。我们将每个证据池限制为八个文档，并向所有排序器传递相同的输入。在此设置中，BM25和MMR作为词汇匹配和多样性优化的可解释参考点。在345个聚类上的实验中，我们发现冗余模式因模型而异：一个LLM在较大的选择预算下会隐式地实现多样化，而另一个LLM则增加了冗余。相比之下，LLM在较小选择预算下的词汇覆盖率表现不佳。因此，LLM的排序结果与两个基线方法均存在显著差异，而非始终近似于其中任何一种策略。通过减少检索方差的干扰……
tldr: 本文提出一种以Multi-News聚类为固定证据池的受控诊断方法，发现LLM重排序器在冗余模式和词汇覆盖方面与BM25、MMR基线行为显著不同，且不同LLM之间也表现出各异的冗余策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a controlled diagnostic using fixed Multi-News evidence pools, revealing that LLM rerankers diverge substantially from BM25 and MMR baselines in redundancy patterns and lexical coverage, with different LLMs exhibiting distinct redundancy behaviors.
